hint.content_not_updated: Update them yourself from the entry's content list to see why, or hold one to keep it where it is.
hint.document_quarantined: Nothing was deleted — the file is at {path}. Update hestia if it came from a newer version, or delete it once you have what you need from it.
hint.import_content_missing: Install them again from a source if you still want them.
hint.launched_offline: Singleplayer works as usual; launch again once you are back online to play multiplayer.
hint.modpack_files_excluded: They would break a server. Add one under Always install in Settings to install it anyway, or turn the correction off to trust the pack.
hint.modpack_overrides_kept: Delete a file under the game directory to take the pack's version of it at the next update.
hint.pack_export_warned: The archive was written. Check what it left out before sharing it.
hint.pack_icon_dropped: The instance was imported without it. Pick an icon in the instance's settings.
hint.pack_setting_dropped: The instance runs on the default. Set it yourself if you want it.
hint.pack_not_moved: Its mods may not load. Move the pack yourself once a build for this version is published.
hint.plugin_hook_failed: The plugin was skipped. Disable or update it if this keeps happening.
hint.launch_arg_dropped: The game runs without it. Update or remove the plugin if it matters.
hint.plugin_permissions_disagree: What you approved came from the package itself, so it is accurate. The listing was wrong or has since changed.
hint.plugin_update_rolled_back: The plugin is still at its old version. Report the problem to its author.
hint.repository_stale: The list may be out of date. Try again when the repository is reachable.
hint.properties_schema_missing: Any key is accepted until it can be derived again, so check spelling yourself. Updating the server re-derives it.
hint.server_list_in_use: Close the game and make the change again, or add the server from the in-game multiplayer screen instead.
hint.server_not_restarted: Start the server yourself once the cause is fixed.
hint.session_not_verified: Singleplayer works as usual; launch again once you are back online to play multiplayer.
hint.sync_unit_skipped: Check the instance's file permissions, then launch it again.
hint.sync_unit_unsupported: This instance keeps its own copy. Sharing {unit} needs Minecraft {requires} or newer.

kind.content_not_updated: {count} item(s) could not be updated before the launch and kept their version.
kind.document_quarantined: {document} could not be read and was set aside: {detail}
kind.import_content_missing: {count} file(s) were not in the archive and had no download, so they were left out.
kind.launched_offline: Playing offline as {account} — this session is not signed in.
kind.modpack_files_excluded: {count} client-only mod(s) the pack called server-compatible were not installed.
kind.modpack_overrides_kept: {count} file(s) you had edited were kept instead of the modpack's.
kind.pack_icon_dropped: The {pack} pack's icon was not used: {detail}
kind.pack_not_moved: The modpack “{pack}” {versionNumber} is built for Minecraft {packGameVersion} and has no version for {target}.
kind.plugin_hook_failed: Plugin {plugin} did not finish its {hook} hook, so it was skipped.
kind.launch_arg_dropped: Plugin {plugin} asked for the launch argument {arg}, which a plugin may not set, so it was dropped.
kind.plugin_permissions_disagree: The repository listed other permissions for {plugin} than its package asks for.
kind.plugin_update_rolled_back: The update of {id} to {version} failed to load and was rolled back: {error}
kind.properties_schema_missing: '{name}' has no property schema, so its server.properties keys cannot be checked.
kind.server_list_in_use: “{instance}” has {sessions} session(s) open, so the running game will overwrite this change to the multiplayer list when it exits.
kind.server_not_restarted: “{server}” was stopped for the update and could not be started again: {detail}
kind.session_not_verified: Could not reach Microsoft to refresh {account}, so this session runs on the stored sign-in.
kind.sync_unit_unsupported: “{instance}” cannot share {unit}: that needs Minecraft {requires} or newer.
